subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the sole protected-environment production deployment authority for openclaw/crawl-remote under this forward-only D1 recovery model?
rationale: Source review can validate the fail-closed mechanics, but ownership of production credentials, the cross-repository cutover sequence, and acceptance of migrations that cannot be rolled back are operational trust decisions.

options.title: Approve staged cutover
options.body: Merge the companion retirement first, land this workflow disabled, provision unique protected credentials, and rehearse dormant rollout and rollback before activation.

options.title: Retain service-owned authority
options.body: Keep production deployment and credentials within openclaw/crawl-remote and do not activate this centralized path.

options.title: Require stronger data recovery
options.body: Pause the cutover until operators approve a different staged migration or database recovery strategy.

recommendation.title: Approve staged cutover
recommendation.body: Merge the companion retirement first, land this workflow disabled, provision unique protected credentials, and rehearse dormant rollout and rollback before activation.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the strongest prior ownership of ClawSweeper's CI, Cloudflare publishing, and release policy surfaces, while vincentkoc can supply implementation details.
